name: palsentry
description: Web dashboard for managing a Palworld dedicated server through its official REST API

scripts.build: npm run build -w @palsentry/web && npm run build -w @palsentry/server
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build -w @palsentry/web && npm run build:desktop-server && npm run build -w @palsentry/desktop
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @palsentry/desktop && concurrently -n server,web,app -c cyan,magenta,green "cross-env PALSENTRY_DESKTOP=1 PALSENTRY_DATA_DIR=.desktop-dev npm run dev:server" "npm:dev:web" "cross-env PALSENTRY_DESKTOP_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 npm run dev -w @palsentry/desktop"
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build:desktop && npm run package -w @palsentry/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @palsentry/server && npm run typecheck -w @palsentry/web && npm run typecheck -w @palsentry/desktop
